## How to test

```bash

```

## Checklist

- [ ] `bun run check` passes locally
- [ ] New data in `content/` ships with the test that keeps it honest
- [ ] New UI has a label, a visible focus ring, and a hit area of at least 36px
- [ ] A design change names the rule it serves (one accent, one radius scale, one marquee)
- [ ] No secrets, no `.env.local` values, no generated artifacts
- [ ] One logical change: no refactor mixed into a feature
